verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as recurring outbound call campaigns or workflows, is a fair question for a voice-agent platform. However, no evidence shows Retell offers recurring schedules. Webhooks are event-driven, data-retention auto-deletion is an adjacent compliance setting, and function calling acts only within a live call. None of these is a user-defined recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
